title: She’s waiting for me, I know. For England, home and beauty. She’s my own true wife I haven’t seen for seven years now, sailing about.
html_source: This is clearly an allusion to Penelope and “The Odyssey.” At first, this story seems strange coming from Murphy but perhaps it serves the purpose of getting Bloom to think about his own situation.

 — That's right, the sailor said. Fort Camden and Fort Carlisle. That's where I hails from. I belongs there. That's where I hails from. My little woman's down there.
anchor.suffix: Mr Bloom could easily picture his advent on this scene, the homecoming to the mariner's roadside shieling after having diddled Davy Jones, a rainy night with a blind moon. Acro
